title: List a customer's invoices
brief: The invoices page lists one customer's invoices. Add Store.ListByCustomer(ctx, tenantID, customerID), newest first, for the signed-in tenant. The store's integration suite covers the SQL (out of this group).
tasks: Add Store.ListByCustomer for the signed-in tenant

expected.why: The query filters by customer_id only; tenantID is accepted and never used, so a customer id from another tenant returns that tenant's invoices.
